content: Individuals with diabetes or prediabetes should be assessed for a history of dieting and disordered eating behaviors during Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) sessions and Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) visits. Nutritional therapy should be tailored to address maladaptive eating patterns, including disordered eating behaviors that may negatively impact diabetes management. Examples of such behaviors include overtreating episodes of hypoglycemia or intentionally reducing medication doses to suppress hunger. If disordered eating behaviors are detected, it is recommended to refer the individual to a qualified behavioral health professional for further evaluation and management.
